description: Leb Soga giloko kwede ki dano milion adek i Busoga, tung wokceng me Uganda, ka ma Kulu Nil cakke iye cok ki Jinja.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Acholi courses (#130) with low confidence in Acholi; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: Leb me **Busoga ki wang Kulu Nil.**
why.text: Leb Soga obedo leb me Jinja, Iganga, Kamuli ki Mayuge, dok cok ki Leb Ganda, ci pwonyone yabo yo i tung wokceng ki dye Uganda. Pwonye pi dog gang, wot, tic, ki wer ki ododo me Busoga.

cards.title: Pi dog gang
cards.text: Lok ki kwaro ki wat i Busoga.

cards.title: Pi luwot
cards.text: Wot cakke ki Jinja cito wa Bujagali ki Buvuma.

cards.title: Pi jo ma mito ngeyo
cards.text: Nong kit nying, nyukuta mabor ki lok mapol ma Leb Soga nywako ki Leb Ganda.

sample.prompt: Lok mene ma tyen lok ne “apwoyo”?

landing.audience: Jo ma loko Leb Acoli ma gicako manyen, dog gang ma oa ki Busoga, ki luwot ma gicito tung wokceng me Uganda.
landing.first: Moto, tito nyingi ki kwan wel, lacen dog gang, cam, cuk, cawa, kabedo, gang ki yot kom, dul ki dul.

cast.emma: Welo ma tye ka pwonye Leb Soga ma peya owoto
